name: How do insurance agencies measure the success of their AEO efforts?

mainEntity.name: How do insurance agencies measure the success of their AEO efforts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Insurance agencies measure AEO success through various metrics. These include an increase in featured snippet impressions and clicks, higher visibility in 'People Also Ask' sections, improved rankings for question-based queries, and a rise in organic traffic originating from direct answers. Voice search analytics, if available, can also indicate success. Ultimately, the most important metrics are lead generation, conversion rates from AEO-driven traffic, and an increase in online inquiries or quote requests. Tracking these allows agencies to quantify the return on investment for their AEO strategies.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO success is measured by increased featured snippet visibility, higher rankings for question-based queries, more organic traffic from direct answers, and ultimately, improved lead generation and conversions.
